tagline: Global leader in mining and cement technologies delivering sustainable productivity solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: Revenue of DKK 20.2 billion in 2024 reflecting FLSmidth's overall performance in the mining and cement industries, despite uncertain macroeconomic conditions and significant strategic transitions.

kpis.name: Total Revenue

kpis.description: FLSmidth's annual consolidated revenue reached DKK 20.2 billion in 2024, demonstrating the company's resilience amid uncertain macroeconomic conditions.
kpis.signal: Revenue of DKK 20.2 billion in 2024, reflecting stable overall activity despite challenging market conditions.

kpis.name: Total Employees

risks.title: Dependence on a complex and high-risk global supply chain
risks.score_rationale: Risk repeatedly and centrally mentioned in the document (dominant supply chain section); strong language ('vast and diverse', 'high-risk countries', '32% of total supplier spend in high forced-labour-risk countries'); upward trend linked to mining geographic concentration; critical category for a global industrial equipment provider.

risks.title: Risk of forced labor and modern slavery in the value chain
risks.score_rationale: Core subject of the filing (Modern Slavery Statement); explicit language on reputational risk ('reputational risk involved with our customers and suppliers potentially using forced labour'); stable trend but under enhanced monitoring; high weight for a company operating in high-risk mining jurisdictions.

risks.title: Non-compliance with modern anti-slavery regulations (Australia, Canada)
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly addressed by two national legislations (Modern Slavery Act 2018 Australia; Fighting Against Forced Labour and Child Labour in Supply Chains Act Canada); compliance-focused language ('reporting entity', 'approved by board'); upward trend with proliferation of ESG laws; moderate weight as FLSmidth appears to be actively compliant.

risks.title: Geographic concentration of operations in high-risk countries
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned ('wide range of countries classified as high-risk based on country classification indices'); direct language on geopolitical exposure linked to mining concentration; upward trend with urbanization and resource concentration; critical category for a global mining equipment provider.

risks.title: Conflict minerals risk in the supply chain
risks.score_rationale: Industry-specific risk addressed via dedicated sub-policy (Conflict Minerals Sub-policy) and focus on 3TG minerals and cobalt; active monitoring language ('updated our conflict minerals policy in 2024'); stable trend with recent update; moderate but sector-specific weight.

risks.title: Insufficient internal training on human rights and compliance
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly identified internal operational risk: e-learning training completion rate at only 74% (target not met, up from 60% in 2023); moderate language ('we acknowledge that more progress is needed'); improving but insufficient trend; limited but revealing organizational vulnerability.

risks.title: Organizational fragmentation in procurement management across Business Lines
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly described structural risk ('divided across different Business Lines with rather independent setups'); nuanced language acknowledging fragmentation while highlighting alignment efforts; stable trend with partial centralization initiatives; significant weight for ESG standard consistency and operational resilience.

risks.title: Reputational risk related to ESG practices of mining and cement customers
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned risk ('reputational risk involved with our customers potentially using forced labour'); FLSmidth has implemented human rights clauses in customer contracts and customer due diligence; upward trend with increasing ESG regulatory pressure; moderate but strategic weight for a leading B2B supplier.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or related technologies in the provided documents. FLSmidth does not position AI as a strategic lever in its current operations.
evidence: No reference to AI, machine learning, or advanced automation tools in the Modern Slavery Act Statement 2024.
Mentioned strategic priorities focus on organizational transformation, decarbonization (MissionZero), and operational simplification.
No mention of products or services incorporating AI in the Mining or Cement segments.
